sentences.en: Dr. Hellebrandt is an associate professor in that excellent university.
sentences.zh: 赫勒布兰特博士是那所优秀大学的一名副教授。

sentences.en: I understand now why he didn't go to a university.
sentences.zh: 我现在明白了他为什么没有上大学。

sentences.en: The university was founded by his father twenty years ago.
sentences.zh: 这所大学是他父亲二十年前创办的。

senses.zh: 综合性大学,大学人员,大学校舍
